app.name: KESMA
app.tagline: Visualize, divide and compare land-division scenarios
app.disclaimerShort: Planning and visualization tool — not a legal, cadastral or valuation instrument.

disclaimer.title: Before you start
disclaimer.body1: KESMA helps families and professionals visualize, measure and compare possible land divisions.
disclaimer.body2: It does not determine legal inheritance rights, ownership, official cadastral boundaries or official land values. Any final division must be validated by the competent professionals (surveyor, notary, lawyer) and authorities.
disclaimer.body3: Your data stays on this device: nothing is sent to a server. Export your projects regularly to keep a backup.

home.subtitle: Projects are stored in this browser only.

settings.title: Project settings

measure.keys: Double-click or Enter: finish · Backspace: undo · Esc: clear

property.emptyBody: Import a GeoJSON, KML/KMZ, Shapefile (.zip), GPX or CSV file, or draw the property on the map.

details.label: Parcel name / identifier
details.ownershipPlaceholder: e.g. title deed no., registered owner

import.title: Import the property

steps.pick: Choose a file containing the property boundaries.
steps.csv: Tell KESMA which columns contain the coordinates.
steps.review: Check the coordinate system and choose the parcels to import.

import.dropHere: Drop a file here or click to browse
import.formats: GeoJSON · KML · KMZ · Shapefile (.zip) · GPX · CSV
import.shapefileHint: Shapefile: zip the .shp, .shx, .dbf and .prj files together. CSV: one row per boundary point, in order.

csv.hint: Points are joined in row order. Use a parcel column to build several polygons.

crs.label: Coordinate system of the file
crs.unsupported: The file declares “{name}”, which is not supported. Choose the correct system.
crs.suggested: No coordinate system declared. Based on the coordinates, {name} is suggested — please check the location below.
crs.lonLat: No coordinate system declared; the values look like longitude/latitude (WGS 84).
crs.none: No coordinate system declared and the coordinates do not match any supported system in Tunisia.

location.outside: Warning: centre is outside Tunisia ({lat}, {lng}). The coordinate system may be wrong.

warnings.linesConvertedToPolygons: Lines/GPS tracks were closed to form polygons — check the shape.
warnings.pointsSkipped: {points, plural, one {# point was ignored} other {# points were ignored}}.
warnings.linesSkipped: {lines, plural, one {# line was too short and ignored} other {# lines were too short and ignored}}.
warnings.invalidSkipped: {invalid, plural, one {# invalid shape was ignored} other {# invalid shapes were ignored}}.
warnings.selfIntersections: Some polygons cross themselves (shown in red); their area is unreliable. They are not selected by default.

import.replace: Replace the {count, plural, one {existing parcel} other {# existing parcels}}
import.selectedSummary: {count, plural, =0 {No parcel selected} one {# parcel selected} other {# parcels selected}} · {area}

errors.unsupportedFormat: This file type is not supported.
errors.tooLarge: The file is too large (max 50 MB).
errors.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON.
errors.invalidGeoJson: The file is not valid GeoJSON.
errors.invalidXml: The file is not valid XML (KML/GPX).
errors.noKmlInKmz: No KML document found inside the KMZ file.
errors.noShpInZip: No .shp file found in the ZIP archive.
errors.shpNotZipped: Shapefiles must be imported as a single .zip containing .shp, .shx, .dbf and .prj.
errors.invalidShapefile: The Shapefile could not be read.
errors.csvNoRows: The CSV file has no data rows (a header row is required).
errors.csvNotEnoughPoints: At least 3 points are needed to form a polygon.
errors.noCoordinates: No valid coordinates found in the selected columns.
errors.noAreaFeatures: No polygon found in this file (with this coordinate system).
errors.reprojectionFailed: Coordinates could not be converted from this coordinate system.
errors.unexpected: Unexpected error while reading the file.

beneficiaries.emptyBody: Add the heirs or co-owners, then enter each share as a fraction (1/8, 7/24…), a percentage, a target area or a part of the remainder.
beneficiaries.legalNote: You enter the shares. KESMA does not determine legal inheritance rights — have them confirmed by a notary or lawyer.

summary.complete: Shares add up to the whole property.
summary.needsProperty: Area-based shares need the property: import or draw it first.
summary.invalid: One of the shares is invalid.
summary.remainderStarved: Beneficiaries taking “the remainder” receive nothing: fixed shares already cover the whole property.
summary.noPropertyYet: Target areas will appear once the property is imported or drawn.

editor.name: Name
editor.fractionInvalid: Enter a fraction such as 1/8 (whole numbers, denominator > 0).
editor.areaNeedsProperty: Needs the property area (import or draw the property).
editor.weightHint: Share of what the fixed shares leave, proportional to the weight (e.g. son = 2, daughter = 1).
editor.deleteBody: “{name}” will be removed from the project.

property.title: Draw the property
property.hint: Click to place each corner. Click the first point or press Enter to finish.

lot.title: Draw a lot
lot.hint: Click each corner (snaps to boundaries). The lot is kept inside the property and outside existing lots. Enter or first point to finish.

split.title: Cut lots
split.hint: Draw a line across one or more lots (snaps to boundaries). Press Enter or click the last point again to cut.

scenarios.needPropertyBody: Scenarios divide the property into lots. Import or draw the property in the Property tab.
scenarios.emptyBody: A scenario is one proposed division of the property. Start from the whole property and cut it into lots, or draw lots yourself.
scenarios.deleteBody: “{name}” and all its lots will be deleted. The property and other scenarios are not affected.
scenarios.coverage: {count, plural, =0 {No lots} one {# lot} other {# lots}} · {lotsArea} of {propertyArea} ({percent})
scenarios.editHint: Click a lot to select it (Shift+click for several). Drag corners to adjust; shared corners move both lots. Drag a yellow midpoint to add a corner, right-click a corner to remove it.
scenarios.noLots: No lots yet: cut the property or draw a lot.

lot.label: Lot name
lot.lockedHint: A locked lot cannot be moved, cut, merged or deleted.
lot.sharedVertex: Shared with {count, plural, one {# lot} other {# lots}}
lot.coordinatesHint: Editing a shared corner (●) also moves it in the neighbouring lots.

toast.deleted: {count, plural, one {Lot deleted} other {# lots deleted}}

errors.noCut: The line must cross a lot completely (from one edge to another).
errors.notAdjacent: Only lots that share an edge can be merged.
errors.locked: Locked lots cannot be changed. Unlock them first.
errors.empty: Nothing to add: the drawn shape is outside the property or already covered by lots.

assign.label: {count, plural, one {Assign the selected lot to} other {Assign the # selected lots to}}
